messages:
ashley: seeing a spike of 503s from sfo1 control plane — console and API authz lookups timing out. anyone on call?
infra-bot: alert: sfo1-controlplane: authz_fetch_latency > 1s (5m avg) — 42% error rate on /authz/check — grafana: https://grafana.redwood/s/dash/sfo1-controlplane
matt: I'm on it, checking control-plane pods and etcd health. quick snapshot: `kubectl get pods -n redwood-controlplane -o wide` returning 2/3 ready on sfo1-cp-1
li: on sfo1 infra — we just finished a node replacement last night, disk IO for cp-1 is high per node-exporter, suspect etcd compaction or backlog. pulling etcd metrics: `etcdctl --endpoints=https://10.10.5.3:2379 endpoint status`
rachel: customers starting to hit console login failures, support getting tickets. maya FYI — please triage customer-impacted list and add to incident page.
maya: noted, creating incident doc and adding 6 users so far. putting public status note on status.redwood.ai (short message)
matt: logs show a lot of grpc timeouts from authz-service to etcd: `rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded desc = context deadline exceeded` — also seeing follower -> leader elections thrashing: leader changes 3 times in last 5m
li: that's consistent with IO spikes. on the control-plane nodes, `iostat` shows 98% iowait on sfo1-cp-1 disk. probable root cause: compaction job coincided with a degraded disk. starting a IO-friendly snapshot rollback if needed.
ashley: urgent mitigation: shift read-heavy authz traffic off sfo1 while we stabilize. we have routing policy to mirror/shift to na-west2. matt/rachel: can we do a partial traffic-shift?
matt: yes — we can flip the router weights for the authz route to 0.2 sfo1 / 0.8 na-west2. using internal-router API:
```
curl -X POST "https://internal-router.redwood/api/v1/shift"
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ROUTER_TOKEN"
  -d '{"route":"authz-check","weights":{"sfo1":0.2,"na-west2":0.8}}'
```
li: netops: any constraints on shifting? BGP / prefix limits? @netops
netops: FYI — we have capacity in na-west2 but network egress quota for sfo1->na-west2 tunnels is near 70%, should be fine for this shift. watch for cross-region traffic costs.
ashley: do it, matt. small step, confirm error rate drops, then move to 0.0 if healthy.
matt: posting change now. rolling weights to 0.8 na-west2 -> 0.2 sfo1.
infra-bot: router-change: success (change_id=chg_8adf3). new weights in effect.
matt: error rate on /authz/check dropped from 42% -> 6% in ~45s. console logins mostly return to normal.
rachel: customers on recent tickets reporting improvement :thumbsup: — keep monitoring for config-rollout stuck issues though, we had a few aborted rollouts earlier.
li: config store replication status shows backlog for sfo1 replicas, controller-manager rollouts pending due to failed reads. we should avoid forcing config rollouts until etcd stabilizes.
matt: started a controlled restart on sfo1-cp-1 kubelet+etcd-proxy to relieve IO. will keep one node offline at a time.
ashley: good. long term: increase cp replicas or move etcd backed store to NVMe pool. open task in infra backlog: CP-1523.
netops: note on cost — cross-region traffic shift will incur delta ~+12% on authz path for the duration, tagging billing alert.
maya: adding customer-facing note to say intermittent auth errors in SFO region, mitigation in progress and most traffic shifted to alternate region.
li: still seeing occasional election events, but follower latency decreasing. planning follow-up to repro compaction schedule and avoid heavy compaction during node replacements.
matt: once control plane stable, we'll run a rolling upgrade of cp nodes to move them to nvme-backed instances.
rachel: thanks team — oncall will watch for next 30m, if error rate stays <5% we can close P1 to P2.
ashley: agreed. leaving incident open for postmortem. assign to li/matt for RCA.
infra-bot: incident update: sfo1 authz latency mitigated by traffic shift — follow-up RCA ticket created: RCA-2026-48
ashley: closing loop for now. good job. :heart:
